name: CalendarManagement
description: Synapp calendar-management app. The Wasm module is a deterministic planner and validator for calendar UI flows and AI tool invocations; the host owns persistence, provider I/O, invites, free/busy, rooms, contacts, reminders, sharing, subscriptions, offline cache, and audit.

exports.name: get_calendar_capabilities
exports.description: Read permission, policy, host-effect, recurrence, offline, sharing, and feature availability.

exports.name: list_calendars
exports.description: List visible and optionally hidden calendars from supplied host snapshots.

exports.name: save_calendar
exports.description: Validate and plan host-owned calendar metadata persistence.

exports.name: delete_calendar
exports.description: Plan calendar delete, hide, or unsubscribe host effects.

exports.name: set_calendar_view_state
exports.description: Plan persistence of calendar view state.

exports.name: list_events
exports.description: Read events for a visible range with permission-limited projections.

exports.name: get_event
exports.description: Read one event or recurring occurrence detail with allowed actions.

exports.name: search_events
exports.description: Search supplied event projections with structured filters.

exports.name: validate_event_draft
exports.description: Validate and normalize an appointment or meeting draft without mutation.

exports.name: create_event
exports.description: Plan appointment or meeting creation with optional invite, conference, and reminder effects.

exports.name: update_event
exports.description: Plan event update, attendee delta, recurrence scope update, and notification effects.

exports.name: delete_event
exports.description: Plan appointment delete, meeting cancellation, occurrence delete, or series cancellation.

exports.name: copy_event
exports.description: Plan copying an event or occurrence to another writable calendar.

exports.name: move_event
exports.description: Plan moving an event to another calendar.

exports.name: validate_recurrence
exports.description: Validate provider-safe recurrence rules and constraints.

exports.name: preview_recurrence
exports.description: Expand upcoming recurrence occurrence previews without host I/O.

exports.name: plan_free_busy_lookup
exports.description: Validate and plan a host-owned free/busy lookup.

exports.name: suggest_meeting_times
exports.description: Score supplied free/busy and room/resource snapshots without host I/O.

exports.name: search_rooms
exports.description: Plan host-owned room/resource lookup and availability check.

exports.name: resolve_attendees
exports.description: Normalize attendee entries and plan contact lookup for unresolved people/resources.

exports.name: list_invitations
exports.description: Read pending and recent invitation projections.

exports.name: get_invitation
exports.description: Read one invitation detail with allowed responses.

exports.name: respond_to_invitation
exports.description: Plan accept, tentative, or decline RSVP host effects.

exports.name: propose_new_time
exports.description: Plan meeting response with proposed time.

exports.name: list_categories
exports.description: Read category labels and colors.

exports.name: save_category
exports.description: Plan saving a category label/color.

exports.name: delete_category
exports.description: Plan category deletion and event category reassignment behavior.

exports.name: bulk_update_events
exports.description: Plan confirmed bulk category, move, copy, delete, privacy, or availability operations.

exports.name: get_sharing_state
exports.description: Read calendar shares, delegates, and allowed sharing actions.

exports.name: update_sharing
exports.description: Plan host-owned sharing or delegated access changes with audit-aware payloads.

exports.name: accept_shared_calendar
exports.description: Plan accepting or provisioning a shared calendar invitation.

exports.name: subscribe_calendar
exports.description: Plan host-owned Internet Calendar subscription sync; Wasm never fetches remote URLs.

exports.name: get_reminder_state
exports.description: Read reminder delivery state for an event or calendar default.

exports.name: snooze_or_dismiss_reminder
exports.description: Plan reminder snooze or dismiss host effects.

exports.name: get_user_preferences
exports.description: Read user calendar preferences and defaults.

exports.name: save_user_preferences
exports.description: Validate and plan saving calendar settings.

exports.name: get_offline_state
exports.description: Read host cache state, last sync timestamp, and offline mutation policy.

exports.name: get_activity_log
exports.description: Read sanitized host audit projections without exposing audit internals or private event details beyond permission.

hostEffects.notes: Calendar side effects are host-owned. The Wasm module validates, normalizes, projects, previews, scores, and returns host-effect plans; it never performs direct network, provider, database, invite, reminder, sharing, subscription, offline, or audit I/O.
